summary.tldr: Expands First Nations fiscal tools, creates an infrastructure institute, and makes related changes to access to information and privacy laws.
what_it_does: Expands and updates the mandates of the First Nations Tax Commission and the First Nations Financial Management Board.
Creates a First Nations Infrastructure Institute to give First Nations and other interested Indigenous groups and organisations tools and support for planning and managing infrastructure.
Gives First Nations named in the Act the power to make laws that regulate services provided by or on behalf of the First Nation.
Changes the Act by adding the Financing Secured by Other Revenues Regulations, combining two debt reserve funds into one, and simplifying pooled borrowing for some Indigenous groups.
Makes related changes to the Access to Information Act and the Privacy Act.
Clarifies a transitional administrative issue linked to the 2019 creation of the Department of Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs and the Department of Indigenous Services.
summary.background: The bill amends the First Nations Fiscal Management Act. It was introduced in the House of Commons on 23 March 2023.
